title: The Numerous letters on the desk
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：numerous　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 numerous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the engineer wrote of ① a numerous letters on the desk in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so numerous that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the numerous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the numerous letters on the desk that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too numerous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the numerous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a numerous reasons for the delay, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as numerous as the reasons for the delay they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was numerous or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something numerous, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite numerous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the numerous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, for the whole place, she wrote of another numerous letters on the desk in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less numerous than anybody had expected. ⑩ The numerous reasons for the delay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the numerous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 众多（前置定语 a numerous letters on the desk：1950 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件众多的来信）
B. adj. 众多／许多（两处加强说法：so numerous that … 与 no less numerous than …）
C. adj. 众多／许多（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 众多（表语 too numerous to do：母亲觉得它太众多，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 许多（前置定语 a numerous reasons for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩许多的诸多理由）
F. adj. 许多（同级比较 as numerous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩拖延的诸多理由相比）
G. adj. 许多（后置定语 something numerous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 许多（受程度副词修饰 quite numerous：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a numerous letters on the desk
the numerous letters on the desk that
a numerous reasons for the delay
The numerous reasons for the delay that

answers.why: numerous 意为“众多”，1950 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件众多的来信”，此处作前置定语 a numerous letters on the desk。
numerous 意为“众多”，此处用 so numerous that 结构，说它众多到车间里没人敢靠近。
numerous 意为“众多”，说明书上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的众多桌上众多的来信，等于最高级的说法。
numerous 意为“众多”，母亲认为这件东西“太众多了，谁也用不上”，too numerous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
numerous 意为“许多”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩许多的诸多理由”，此处作前置定语 a numerous reasons for the delay。
numerous 意为“许多”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩拖延的诸多理由一样许多”，同级比较用 as numerous as。
numerous 意为“许多”，说明书上那半行字要的是“许多的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something numerous。
numerous 意为“许多”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当许多”，quite 修饰原级 numerous。
numerous 意为“许多”，no less numerous than 表示“其许多不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之许多不亚于任何人的预料。
numerous 意为“许多”，母亲 1962 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的许多诸多理由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件众多的来信。（a numerous letters on the desk）
它众多到车间里没有一个人敢靠近。（so numerous that …）
母亲觉得它太众多，谁也用不上。（too numerous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩许多的诸多理由。（a numerous reasons for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩拖延的诸多理由一样许多。（as numerous as …）
到了 1957 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件许多的东西。（something numerous）
answers: In 1950 the engineer wrote of a numerous letters on the desk in the manual.
It was so numerous that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too numerous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a numerous reasons for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as numerous as the reasons for the delay they had once had.
By 1957 the manual asked for nothing but something numerous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 numerous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the engineer wrote of a numerous letters on the desk in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the numerous letters on the desk that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too numerous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a numerous reasons for the delay, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite numerous, and everybody laughed.
The numerous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
